name: 66701 · Fort Scott, KS
findings: ZIP 66701 (Fort Scott) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 66701 (Fort Scott) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
32% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 66701 (Fort Scott) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).
